title: Rackspace Spot Cloud Platform Hit by Security Breach
excerpt: Rackspace notifies customers of a security breach on its Spot platform involving compromised credentials and unauthorized workload deployment.
body_html:
Rackspace has issued warnings to customers regarding a security breach affecting its Rackspace Spot cloud platform. According to the company, attackers managed to compromise system credentials.

This unauthorized access allowed the intruders to deploy unapproved workloads within customer environments. Additionally, the breach granted the threat actors the ability to access Kubernetes secrets located inside customer clusters.

Rackspace is currently communicating with affected users as the investigation and response to the security incident continue.
